hook: WHY DOES SHIVA WEAR A *TIGER'S SKIN?
title: 19 · pine_forest · The Beggar in the Pine Forest
lines: n
A tiger once leapt out of a fire to kill a beggar.
n
The beggar did not even turn his head.
n
In the pine forest lived sages who had mastered every ritual.
They believed their rituals ran the universe. Not God.
n
One morning a beggar wandered in.
Almost naked. A bowl in his hand. A deer at his heel.
n
And every person in the forest stopped what they were doing, and followed him.
n
The sages were furious.
They poured their anger into the fire, and a tiger came out.
n
He caught it with one hand,
and wrapped its skin around his waist.
n
They sent a serpent. He hung it round his neck.
They sent a demon dwarf. He stepped on it.
n
And then, standing on that dwarf,
he began to dance.
n
The sages fell to their knees.
Every weapon they had thrown, he was now wearing.
n
What the world throws at you can become what you wear. That is sadhana.
n
